summary_en: The Bank of Iwate raised its fiscal 2027 interim dividend to 33 yen per share from 29 yen, and revised its full-year dividend forecast to 67 yen per share from 58 yen, reflecting upward earnings revisions driven by stronger-than-expected loan interest income and securities income.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Earnings Forecasts and Interim Dividend (Increase) and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Increase)
translation_en_brief:
The Bank of Iwate announced revisions to its fiscal 2027 earnings forecasts and dividend policy on November 12, 2026. Consolidated ordinary profit is forecast to increase to 16.6 billion yen from 14.5 billion yen, and net income attributable to parent company shareholders to 11.5 billion yen from 10.0 billion yen, representing increases of 14.4% and 15.0% respectively. Earnings per share is revised to 166.27 yen from 144.85 yen.

The interim dividend for the six-month period ending September 30, 2026 was set at 33 yen per share, up 4 yen from the previously forecasted 29 yen. The year-end dividend forecast was raised to 34 yen per share from 29 yen, an increase of 5 yen. Consequently, the full-year dividend forecast for fiscal 2027 is now 67 yen per share, compared to the prior forecast of 58 yen per share. The dividend increases reflect the stronger operational performance, primarily driven by loan interest income and securities interest and dividend income exceeding initial projections. The interim dividend will take effect on December 10, 2026, with a record date of September 30, 2026, and will be sourced from retained earnings.
